exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: How did your parents choose your name(s)?

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Does your name have any special meaning?

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Is your name common or unusual in your country?

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: If you could change your name, would you? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a TV documentary you watched that was particularly interesting. You should say: what the documentary was about why you decided to watch it what you learnt during the documentary and explain why the TV documentary was particularly interesting.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: What are the most popular kinds of TV programmes in your country? Why is this?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Do you think there are too many game shows on TV nowadays? Why?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you think TV is the main way for people to get the news in your country? What other ways are there?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: What types of products are advertised most often on TV?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Do you think that people pay attention to adverts on TV? Why do you think that is?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: How important are regulations on TV advertising?
